_comment: Tiered, machine-gradable accuracy benchmark for the three co-resident Qwen backends. Each item has the difficulty TIER the router should pick, a known ANSWER, and a deterministic GRADER (no judge model). Used two ways: (1) answer accuracy per backend, (2) routing accuracy of Vela 2.0 vs these human tier labels. Every answer here is a verifiable fact or exact arithmetic.

grader_types.exact: normalized (lowercase, trimmed, punctuation-stripped) last-token or full-string equality against any listed answer
grader_types.contains: any listed normalized answer appears as a substring of the normalized model output
grader_types.numeric: the last number parsed from the output equals the answer within 1e-6
grader_types.fraction: output matches the fraction OR its decimal value within 1e-3
